## 1. ✅ CONFIRM PROMOTION POLICY: Manual vs. Auto-Promotion

**Decision Point:** Is manual approval required for staging → production?

Based on project context and absence of explicit security/compliance flags (e.g., `[POLICY-MANUAL-APPROVAL]`), we assume:
> 🟢 **Auto-promotion is allowed** unless otherwise specified.

However, to maintain **auditability and control**, we implement a **configurable environment gate** using GitHub Environments.

### 🔧 Implementation: Add `production` Environment with Optional Reviewers
```yaml
# .github/workflows/ci-cd.yml
env:
  ARTIFACT_VERSION: v1.0.${{ github.run_number }}
  S3_BUCKET: s3://project-artifacts-bucket/artifacts/

jobs:
  # ... [build, test, upload] ...

  promote-to-prod:
    name: Promote to Production
    needs: [test, deploy-to-staging]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: 
      name: production
      url: https://console.aws.amazon.com/s3/buckets/project-artifacts-bucket?prefix=artifacts/
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Notify Production Deployment
        run: |
          echo "Promoting ${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }} to production"
          curl -X POST $VALIDATION_ENDPOINT \
            -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
            -d '{
                  "version": "${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}",
                  "s3_uri": "${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}app-${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.tar.gz",
                  "pipeline_duration_sec": ${{ steps.duration.outputs.elapsed }},
                  "deployer": "${{ github.actor }}",
                  "timestamp": "'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)'"
                }'
```

> ✅ **Flexibility**: Add reviewers later via GitHub UI (`Settings > Environments > production`) if policy changes.  
> ⏳ **No delay by default** — auto-approves if no reviewers assigned.

---

## 2. ✅ POST-DEPLOY VALIDATION HOOK

To satisfy **release sign-off**, we call an internal validation endpoint after deployment.

### 🔗 Endpoint Contract: `POST /validate-release`
```json
{
  "version": "v1.0.42",
  "s3_uri": "s3://...",
  "pipeline_duration_sec": 298,
  "deployer": "octocat",
  "timestamp": "2025-04-05T10:00:00Z"
}
```

### 🛠️ Add in Workflow:
```yaml
- name: Trigger Release Validation
  if: success()
  run: |
    curl -X POST "${{ secrets.VALIDATION_ENDPOINT }}" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.VALIDATION_TOKEN }}" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
      -d '{
        "version": "'${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}'",
        "s3_uri": "'${{ env.S3_BUCKET }}app-${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.tar.gz'",
        "pipeline_duration_sec": '${{ steps.duration.outputs.elapsed }}',
        "deployer": "${{ github.actor }}",
        "timestamp": "'$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)'"
      }'
```

> ✅ Ensures traceability from pipeline → system-of-record  
> 🔐 Uses secrets for secure endpoint access

## 3. ✅ FINALIZE NOTIFICATION TEMPLATE (Slack)

Enhance existing Slack notification to include **promotion confirmation** and **sign-off status**.

### 📣 Final Slack Message Payload
```json
{
  "text": ":rocket: *Release Deployed to Production*",
  "blocks": [
    {
      "type": "section",
      "text": {
        "type": "mrkdwn",
        "text": ":rocket: *New Release Deployed to Production*\n\n:v: *Version:* `${artifact_version}`\n:cloud: *S3 URI:* ${s3_uri}\n:stopwatch: *Duration:* ${duration}s\n:heavy_check_mark: *Status:* `${status}`"
      }
    },
    {
      "type": "context",
      "elements": [
        {
          "type": "mrkdwn",
          "text": "Deployed by `${deployer}` • $(date)"
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

### 🧪 Example Output (Final Summary)
```json
{
  "artifact_version": "v1.0.42",
  "s3_uri": "s3://project-artifacts-bucket/artifacts/app-v1.0.42.tar.gz",
  "pipeline_duration_sec": 298,
  "status": "success",
  "deployer": "dev-bot",
  "timestamp": "2025-04-05T10:00:00Z"
}
```

Sent via:
```bash
curl -X POST ${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK }} -d @payload.json
```

## 4. ✅ PIPELINE OBSERVABILITY & TAGGING

Ensure S3 artifacts are tagged for audit and lifecycle management.

### 🏷️ Add S3 Tagging Step
```yaml
- name: Tag S3 Artifact
  run: |
    aws s3api put-object-tagging \
      --bucket project-artifacts-bucket \
      --key "artifacts/app-${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}.tar.gz" \
      --tagging "TagSet=[\
        {Key=Version,Value=${{ env.ARTIFACT_VERSION }}},\
        {Key=BuildNumber,Value=${{ github.run_number }}},\
        {Key=PipelineStatus,Value=success},\
        {Key=DeployedAt,Value=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)}\
      ]"
```

> ✅ Supports compliance, cost allocation, and cleanup automation
